messages:
marc: Thanks for joining the allhands earlier. Quick follow-up here for questions about the hiring/headcount changes. Recording + notes: https://redwood.internal/all-hands/1760000123 :film_projector:
sophia: To summarize: we're shifting hiring capacity toward Platform Reliability and Dedicated to meet enterprise demand. This is a reallocation, not a shutdown of product efforts.
alexa: Key change: immediate pause on non-critical external requisitions for two weeks while we review and reallocate ~10 recruiter FTE-equivalents. Some teams will gain slots, others will be paused.
devon: Can you share concrete numbers rather than "some"? Our managers need to plan.
sophia: High level: company size ~150. Net hiring buys cut by ~7% for Q2 (roughly 10 reqs paused), about 5-7 roles reallocated to Platform Reliability/Dedicated. We'll publish the paused list and owners by EOD.
cheng: Are layoffs expected? This thread needs clarity for ICs and leads.
sophia: No mass layoffs planned. Primary action is hiring pauses and reprioritization. We will do a 2-week petition window for managers to request exceptions. If any role is impacted beyond hiring pause we'll handle that through 1:1s and People Ops.
paul: Recruiting process: all open reqs default to `paused` unless approved as `critical-hire` by an exec. Managers: submit a justification ticket to #recruiting-approvals with impact metrics; expect a 48-hour response.
hr-bot: Heads-up: manager talking points doc + petition form: https://redwood.internal/hr/headcount-q2. Confidential support available via People Ops.
marc: Suggested manager script (feel free to copy): "Leadership is prioritizing enterprise reliability. We're pausing some external hires for two weeks while we review. If your role is affected, we'll discuss options privately and aim to minimize disruption."
devon: How will Platform Reliability be organized? New team/reporting?
sophia: It will be a new function under Eng Infra with close ties to Product for SLA ownership. Org chart update will be posted by EOW.
cheng: If someone wants to transfer into Platform Reliability, can they apply?
paul: Yes  internal transfers are prioritized. Flag internal candidates as `internal-fasttrack` and expect a one-week turnaround for interviews.
alexa: What about contractors and renewals?
sophia: Contractors reviewed case-by-case; expect some renewals deferred. Critical contractors can be extended with approval.
marc: Research hiring: are specialized ML roles being paused? We need continuity on model roadmap work.
alexa: Research roles tied directly to inference performance or delivery (runtime optimizations, quantization, Dedicated features) are eligible to continue. Route those through recruiting-approvals and tag `inference-impact`.
devon: Will leveling or interview bar change?
sophia: No leveling freeze. We will tighten approvals to prioritize high-impact hires and add an infra/product reviewer to panels for Dedicated-related roles.
paul: I'll post the list of paused requisitions + owners in #all-hands-updates by EOD. Managers: prepare your petition tickets now if you think a req must stay open.
hr-bot: Severance & benefits FAQ: https://redwood.internal/hr/severance-q2. DM People Ops for confidential conversations.
marc: Appreciate the questions. We know this is stressful  we'll aim for transparent updates and fast decisions. Closing the thread; will repost when paused-reqs + org chart are live.
